mapper.select: select u.user_id , u.user_name , u.email , u.phone , u.user_type , u.status , u.joined_at , u.withdrawn_at , p.birth_date , p.gender , p.country , p.pass_count , p.report_received_count , p.profile_url from user u join user_person p on u.user_id = p.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}

select u.user_id , u.user_name , u.email , u.phone , u.user_type , u.status , u.joined_at , u.withdrawn_at , c.biz_reg_no , c.company_name , c.ceo_name , c.company_address from user u join user_company c on u.user_id = c.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT notice_id , notice_title , notice_content , reg_date , readcount , user_type , update_date , status FROM notice
SELECT notice_id , notice_title , notice_content , reg_date , readcount FROM notice WHERE notice_id = #{notice_id}
SELECT job_id , comp_id , title , field , open_date , close_date , post_check FROM job_posting

select p.pay_id , p.user_id , u.user_name , u.phone , u.user_type , p.product_id , pd.product_name , p.pay_method , p.card_name , p.bank_name , p.deposit_account , p.deposit_name , p.pay_price , p.pay_date , p.pay_status from pay p join product pd on p.product_id = pd.product_id join user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where p.pay_id = #{id}
